270.reason: Full Greek 269–271, canonical context and published control distinguish Lupus's tears (269) from removing his garment and complaining of cold (270). The control has had laid, where canonical has laid; skipped-word back-projection wrongly captured tears. The unique for when cut correctly preserves the English connective and Greek 270's garment/cold episode. Whiston places Cherea's one-stroke death at the end of this English interval although it opens Greek 271; record that inherited distribution separately, without reordering text.
